description: Build a hierarchy of macro machines with increasing block sizes. Outer machines simulate inner machines at an accelerated rate, enabling exploration of machines with very long runtimes.
mathematical_formalization: MacroTM(M, k) groups k consecutive cells; one macro-step = k^O(1) base steps
implementation_hypothesis: Implement multi-level macro machine with block sizes 2,4,8; detect and accelerate repeating patterns at each level
experiment_seed: Benchmark against known BB(5) champion: measure speedup at each macro level
